svg.title: Habitat — cross-section
svg.desc: Cross-section of the pressure vessel through the main cabin: floor, underfloor tanks, lockers, heights, Maya at 1.7 m, “down” and the direction to the spin axis.
svg.text: Cut through the chair, X = 1.75 m (habitat local frame), looking forward; +Y on the left
to spin axis (+Z): floor 28 m from axis
cabin “up” points to the ship axis
“down” is radially outward, away from the axis
at Maya’s head 0.47 g — height gradient
